explanation: Sort the values, fix one position, and move two pointers through the remaining suffix. Skip repeated fixed values and pointer values after each match so every triple appears once.
timeComplexity: O(n squared) time for n values.
spaceComplexity: O(log n) sorting stack excluding up to O(n²) output.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Java algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
